#packages

```{r}
library(usethis)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
library(dplyr)
library(countrycode)
library(remotes)

remotes::install_github("vincentarelbundock/countrycode/r")

```

#read data

```{r}
HDR25 <- read.csv("/Users/geonhuilee/Desktop/UCL/CASA0005/Week 4/HDR25_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv")
WORLD <- st_read("/Users/geonhuilee/Desktop/UCL/CASA0005/Week 4/World_Countries_(Generalized)_2173680399808997149.geojson")
```

#subset data and join

```{r}
GII_subset <- HDR25%>% select(iso3, country, gii_2010, gii_2019)
GII_subset$gii_diff <- GII_diff

GII_subset$ISO <- countrycode(GII_subset$iso3, origin = "iso3c", destination = "iso2c")

WORLD_GII <- WORLD %>% left_join(GII_subset, by = "ISO")
```
